peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: With a GMWB rider, you can withdraw a guaranteed percentage of your principal, regardless of how much your investment's value has declined. The maximum amount you can withdraw each year with a GMWB varies, but is usually between 5% and 10% of the original lump-sum principal you paid to the insurance company.

A living benefit rider guarantees a payout while the annuitant is still alive. A death benefit rider protects beneficiaries against a decline in the annuity's value.
